mohfw-restrict.title: MoHFW, Advisory on Air Pollution and Health (NPCCHH), November 2025
mohfw-restrict.quote: pregnant women, young children and elderly should restrict outdoor movements as far as possible

mohfw-reschedule.title: MoHFW, Advisory on Air Pollution and Health (NPCCHH), November 2025
mohfw-reschedule.quote: Reschedule outdoor activities as per AQI, and remain indoors on days with poor to severe AQI

mohfw-no-exercise.title: MoHFW, Advisory on Air Pollution and Health (NPCCHH), November 2025 (quote corrected for scan errors)
mohfw-no-exercise.quote: Avoid outdoor morning and late evening walk, run, jog and physical exercise

mohfw-school.title: MoHFW, Advisory on Air Pollution and Health (NPCCHH), November 2025, schools annexure
mohfw-school.quote: Physical activities like running, jogging, playing may be avoided or postponed

mohfw-car.title: MoHFW, Advisory on Air Pollution and Health (NPCCHH), November 2025, driving advice

mohfw-n95.title: MoHFW, Advisory on Air Pollution and Health (NPCCHH), November 2025, masks
mohfw-n95.quote: disposable N95 or N99 is useful provided user instructions are followed. These masks may help provided the period of exposure is short.

mohfw-airing.title: MoHFW, Advisory on Air Pollution and Health (NPCCHH), November 2025 (quote corrected for scan errors)
mohfw-airing.quote: Do not open external doors and windows during morning and late evening hours, it may ventilate if necessary, between 12 p.m. to 4 p.m. in afternoon

epa-small-children.title: US EPA, Protect yourself from wildfire smoke and ash: respirators do not come in sizes for young children

app-no-data.title: Saans rule: with no air data for the hours of a routine, leave it as planned and say so

app-not-scheduled.title: Saans rule: a routine that is not on the plan day's weekday is left as it is

app-essential-kinds.title: Saans rule: a commute or a school run is a trip that cannot be dropped, so it gets protection instead of a cancellation

app-window-gain.title: Saans rule: offer another time only if it lowers the air quality level or cuts PM2.5 by at least 20 percent, and only if that time is Moderately polluted or better for children, older adults and people with conditions (Poor or better for other adults)

app-poor-day-hours.title: Saans rule: on a Poor or worse day, offer no time before 10:00 or after 19:00, and move a moderate or hard routine that falls outside those hours (MoHFW advises against outdoor exercise in the morning and late evening)

app-child-hours.title: Saans rule: children, teenagers, infants, under-5s and older adults stay within 07:00 to 19:00, and children and teenagers also stay outside school hours on weekdays (08:00 to 14:00) unless free hours are given

app-airing-length.title: Saans rule: open the windows for one hour, in the cleanest hour between 12:00 and 16:00 (MoHFW names that window)

app-top-action.title: Saans rule: the one action at the top is the most serious thing the plan asks of the family that day
